Banking, Sustainability, Regulation and Ethics

This module introduces different types of banks, banking products, customer needs, personal finance, financial intermediation, financial technology and the role of regulators. It also examines ethical theories, Corporate Social Responsibility, sustainability goals and reporting, together with financial scandals, regulatory failures and financial crises, to develop informed and responsible decision-making.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Compare and contrast the different types of banks, banking products and customer needs.

+  Explain intermediation and the key characteristics.

+  Discuss the different regulators in the banking industry and their different roles.

+  Explain the key ethical theories and objections covered, and analyse their effectiveness in relation to financial scandals and regulation.

+  Recognise the common goals of sustainability and corporate social responsibility by exploring the involvement of the united nations and other organisations.
